project: Split Oversized CLI Root and Run Tests
description: Mechanically reorganize the oversized CLI root and run-invocation test files into focused command- or behavior-group files within their existing packages, preserving the exact test inventory, assertions, observable behavior, and package coverage while reducing contention for active CLI delivery lanes.

context.customerAsk: Split pkg/transports/cli/root_run_test.go and pkg/transports/cli/run/run_invocation_test.go into focused files with shared fixtures in package-local helper test files. Work from current origin/main, accept mechanical rework after concurrent CLI lanes merge, and regenerate rather than hand-merge generated CLI contract artifacts if contention reaches them.
context.problem: Two oversized test files concentrate many independent CLI command and behavior groups, forcing active exit-code, remote-placement, grammar, and cutover lanes to contend on the same files and increasing navigation, review, and rework cost.
context.solution: Capture baseline test inventories and coverage for both packages, mechanically move unchanged tests into focused files in their existing packages, relocate only genuinely shared fixtures into package-local helper test files, keep resulting files at or below approximately 1,200 lines, and prove identical discovery, behavior, and coverage after the split.

acceptanceCriteria: The before/after go test -list '.*' outputs for both affected packages have identical discovered test names, and the PR shows the normalized diffs.
The focused CLI root and run package tests pass after the split, with no test assertion, input, expected output, or customer-observable CLI behavior changed.
Before/after package coverage results are recorded in the PR and are unchanged for both affected packages.
No resulting hand-maintained Go test file in the split is above approximately 1,200 lines, and tests remain grouped by coherent command or behavior responsibility in their existing packages.

The final branch is rebased onto current origin/main; overlapping semantic test changes from merged lanes are retained and the mechanical moves are redone as needed. Generated CLI contract artifacts are never hand-merged and, if affected by reconciliation, are regenerated through the contracts/cli/commands.json flow.

Typecheck, focused package tests, and required CI pass; there are no NEW lint violations relative to current main, and the gates green on main (backend-size, pkg-maint, pkg-file-count, pkg-structure, vet) stay green.
The implementation/review loop continues until required CI is terminal and passing, all blocking PR conversation feedback is explicitly addressed, merge conflicts are resolved, and the PR is merged.

userStories.title: Preserve CLI root test behavior in focused groups
userStories.description: As a CLI maintainer, I want root command tests organized into focused behavior groups so that I can change or review one command area without navigating or contending on a single oversized test file.
acceptanceCriteria: Every test discovered from pkg/transports/cli/root_run_test.go on the implementation baseline remains discoverable under the same test name in the pkg/transports/cli package after the split.
A normalized before/after diff of go test -list '.*' for ./pkg/transports/cli is empty and is included in the PR evidence.
Existing root-test assertions, inputs, expected outputs, fixture semantics, and CLI outcomes are unchanged; the diff is limited to mechanical moves and necessary package-local fixture relocation.

Root tests are grouped into focused command- or behavior-owned test files, genuinely shared fixtures live in focused package-local helper test files, and no resulting split test file is above approximately 1,200 lines.
Before/after coverage for ./pkg/transports/cli is recorded in the PR and unchanged.
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: 2026-08-10: mechanically split pkg/transports/cli/root_run_test.go into focused completion, selection, composition, input, flags, run-config, and operator-default test files plus root_run_test_helpers_test.go. The normalized ./pkg/transports/cli go test -list '.*' inventory stayed at 273 names with an empty diff; before/after coverage stayed at 67.6%. Focused package tests, go vet, backend-size, pkg-maint, and pkg-file-count pass; the largest new split file is 548 lines.
